data.short_meaning: Better, kind, from the house of God
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German name 'Bettina' meaning 'better' or 'kind'. The name 'Bet' means house of and 'Tina' means God in Hebrew. Thus, Bettina means 'from the house of God' or 'Better, kind from the house of God'. The name Bettina carries the meaning “Better, kind, from the house of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bettina usually hope their child will grow to embody better, kind, from the house of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
